name: Cyclist Imogen

intro.text: I have the right of way, the right bike and a basket with a baguette in it. It's a cliché and it's mine. En garde.

win: Fair enough. Mind the cobbles, they've broken better bikes than mine.
after: Oxford has more cyclists than cars in the centre, and a thing called Bicycle Theft, where the bikes go missing on the same days as the students. Lock it twice. Then once more.
